Singer Jasmine Sandlas Announces Engagement During Live Concert

Singer Jasmine Sandlas announced her engagement during the opening night of her 'The Dream Girl India Tour' in Delhi. She called her fiancé, Shekhar Chaudhary, onto the stage, showed her engagement ring, and shared a romantic moment with him. Sandlas is 40 years old. Videos of the announcement have gone viral on social media.
